name: FunctionField
summary: The univariate rational function field over k; F<x> := FunctionField(k) names its generator x.
doc: R0a constructs rational functions in one variable over the integers, rationals or a prime field. Repeating a constructor for the same constants returns the same parent; a new generator name renames that shared parent.

examples.expected:
Univariate rational function field over Rational Field
Variables: x
(x^2 + 1)/(x - 1)

differs: Only rational function fields in one variable over the integers, rationals or a prime field are implemented; algebraic function fields, non-prime finite constants and more variables are refused.

name: RationalFunctionField
summary: The univariate rational function field over k: the same parent as FunctionField(k).

examples.expected:
Univariate rational function field over GF(5)
Variables: t

differs: Only one variable over the integers, rationals or a prime field is implemented.

name: FieldOfFractions
summary: The fraction field of a univariate polynomial ring over the integers, rationals or a prime field.

examples.expected:
Univariate rational function field over Integer Ring
Variables: x

differs: Only univariate polynomial rings over the integers, rationals or a prime field are implemented.

name: FractionField
summary: A Sagebrush compatibility alias for FieldOfFractions(P).

examples.expected:
Univariate rational function field over Rational Field
Variables: x

differs: This compatibility alias is not bound by Magma 2.18; use FieldOfFractions for code intended for that version.
Only univariate polynomial rings over the integers, rationals or a prime field are implemented.

name: BaseField
summary: The constant field of a rational function field whose ground structure is a field.

name: PartialFractionDecomposition
summary: The proper part of f as triples of an irreducible denominator, its power and a numerator.
doc: The returned triples $<p,e,a>$ reconstruct the proper part as the sum of $a/p^e$. A polynomial part is omitted, as in Magma.
differs: Available only for the R0a rational function fields and subject to their degree, coefficient and factorization work limits.

name: SquarefreePartialFractionDecomposition
summary: The proper part of f grouped by squarefree denominator factors and their powers.
doc: The returned triples $<p,e,a>$ reconstruct the proper part as the sum of $a/p^e$, with squarefree p.
differs: Available only for the R0a rational function fields and subject to their degree, coefficient and factorization work limits.
